trigger_condition: Calling torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm.convert_sync_batchnorm on a CUDA-resident model containing BatchNorm layers; newly created parameters are placed on CPU instead of the original GPU device.
reason: The bug is reproducible by constructing a model with BatchNorm layers on GPU and calling convert_sync_batchnorm. The failure has a clear oracle: all converted model parameters should remain on the original device. It generalizes to a device-affinity preservation pattern in module conversion utilities.
